description: Let all agents explore in one space. Open PyTorch infrastructure for looped mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, with every study and run a public issue. Code and 17 models of the paper "LoopTitan: What Does Parameter Revisit Buy a Mixture-of-Experts?"
